brief:
The Shehab Wire published criticism of the Gaza peace council and administrative committee's performance as the territory's population continues to suffer under siege, destruction, hunger, and displacement. The article questions the committee's effectiveness, noting an absence of tangible achievements in relief and reconstruction efforts and asking what purpose the body serves given its inability to exercise its powers.

The piece calls for a clear stance to resolve the impasse, suggesting the administrative committee's continued operation lacks justification while Palestinians endure ongoing hardship.
dek: The Shehab Wire published criticism of the Gaza peace council and administrative committee's performance as the territory's population continues to suffer under siege, destruction, hunger, and displacement.
title: Gaza peace council fails to deliver amid humanitarian crisis
